name: Apply patch f4e116f1 + run the 4 write-path acceptance checks
description:
Follow-up to card f4e116f1-1792-4191-b75a-d3a7f21b84a6 (project_manager writes must merge into the persisted card).

The 4-hunk fix exists as a reviewable patch but is NOT applied, because the acting coworker profile has no shell and no line-range write:
  patches/f4e116f1-project-manager-merge.patch  (125 lines, +125/-0, 4 hunks)

Hunks:
  1. chat_manager.py:1408 save_chat — remove every other *.{id}.json/.yaml file for the id except chat.file_path, skipping /.archive/.
  2. chat_manager.py:1532 load_chat_from_path — set chat.file_path = chat_file.
  3. chat_manager.py:1633 find_by_id — collect all matches, pick max(mtime), log an error when >1 exists.
  4. project_manager_tools.py:2624 _append_comment — reload the persisted card, re-apply its fields onto the caller's object, then append and save.

To do (needs an actor with a shell):
  git apply --check -p1 patches/f4e116f1-project-manager-merge.patch
  git apply -p1 patches/f4e116f1-project-manager-merge.patch

Then paste on card f4e116f1 all four read-backs:
  1. update_task(chat_id=X, wake_at="+2d") alone -> column/status/progress unchanged.
  2. update_task(chat_id=X, board="IT team", column="Doing") alone -> wake_at and priority unchanged.
  3. request_help(comment=...) alone -> column/status/wake_at unchanged.
  4. after a column move exactly one file matches *.{id}.json under .codx/tasks, in the folder of its declared column (glob output pasted).

Also owed: a regression test for 1-3, blocked by 0dd3f3d4 (pytest:api cannot collect, 48 collection errors) — do not skip the read-back or --ignore tests to make this pass.

Do NOT merge with card 0159931a (live-turn race during a running turn): different mechanism, deliberately sequenced behind this one.

messages.content: Apply patches/f4e116f1-project-manager-merge.patch with git apply, then run the four acceptance read-backs and paste them on card f4e116f1.
